1.consolidated_definition: Reducir grasa. Disminuir la grasa del cuerpo o la cantidad de alimentos productores de grasa en el organismo. Calco de estructura, poco frecuente. Véase fat. Desarrollan fármaco contra la obesidad. Existen modelos que permiten cortar grasa firme en lonjas de un espesor regulable (E-Industria.com, consultado 22-09-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Reduce body fat. Decrease the amount of fatty tissue in the body or the quantity of fatty foods within the organism. Calque of structure, relatively infrequent. See fat. Develops a pharmaceutical against obesity. There exist models that allow for firm cutting of fat into slices of a regulable thickness (E-Industry.com, consulted 22-09-08)
